decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with the goal of overwhelming the opponent quickly. It utilizes the Cascade mechanic to gain card advantage and tempo, constantly pressuring the opponent with powerful spells. The deck also incorporates a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production. The main creatures in the deck are Shardless Agent and Scion of Draco, both contributing to the card advantage and threatening the opponent's life total. The deck also includes disruptive elements with Force of Negation and Subtlety, preventing opponent's plays and maintaining control. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the board early on and secure victory before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while applying pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The deck also utilizes Undying Evil to protect key creatures and maximize value. The mana base is designed to enable consistent access to the necessary colors for the spells while also providing some utility lands for additional options.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and efficient spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By including Jegantha as a companion, it adds an extra level of consistency to the deck. The main win condition is to play threats such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Territorial Kavu, and Tarmogoyf to apply pressure while using spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck also uses Leyline Binding and Tribal Flames to control the board and finish off the opponent. The mana base is well-tailored to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

The main idea behind this deck is to assemble a toolbox of creatures with a variety of abilities, using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for specific creatures as needed. The deck also aims to generate value through sacrificing creatures with abilities like Blood Artist and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. By utilizing a mix of resilient creatures, sacrifice outlets, and creature tutors, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while also presenting a combo finish with cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and various support cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By combining hand disruption with fast, evasive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to control the game early while dealing direct damage with cards like Grief and Fury. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional value by bringing back key creatures from the graveyard. With a mix of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, this deck aims to maintain pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly putting out creatures with Cascade abilities to overwhelm the opponent. The goal is to cast spells that provide additional value through Cascade while also controlling the board with counter spells and removal. The mana base is optimized to consistently hit the necessary colors for casting spells and the creatures in the deck are resilient threats that are difficult to deal with. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and land destruction. The goal is to outvalue and overpower the opponent with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and by generating immense amounts of mana with cards like Cabal Coffers. Karn, the Great Creator acts both as a threat and a way to tutor for key artifacts. The deck aims to grind out the opponent with a combination of sheer power and resource denial.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively disrupt your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while utilizing efficient removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to maintain board control. The deck also utilizes creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. Through constant threats and disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize and take control of the game.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and controlling the board until it can play its key combo of Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By sacrificing lands and searching for Mountains with Scapeshift, the deck can deal massive amounts of direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes versatile removal in Lightning Bolt and consistency through card draw effects like Explore. The One Ring and Wish add flexibility and the ability to search for specific answers, while Wrenn and Six provide additional recursion and card advantage.

This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that allows you to mill your own library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer help to dig for combo pieces while Mox Amber and Urza's Saga provide mana acceleration. Teferi, Time Raveler can protect your combo from disruption, and Unholy Heat helps to control the board. The inclusion of Rona, Herald of Invasion and Flame of Anor provide additional value and synergy with the combo pieces.

Utilizing the synergy between lands and creatures, this deck aims to quickly ramp into powerful threats like Primeval Titan while abusing the powerful Amulet of Vigor to gain maximum value from lands that enter the battlefield tapped. By constantly searching for key pieces with cards like Summoner's Pact and Tolaria West, the deck can quickly assemble its combo pieces or overwhelm opponents with a massive board presence. With the right combination of lands and creatures, this deck can quickly close out games with explosive plays and overwhelming force.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures through the use of Chord of Calling, allowing for flexibility in dealing with various situations. By utilizing creatures like Young Wolf, Strangleroot Geist, and Wall of Roots, the deck aims to create a strong board presence while also utilizing creatures with powerful abilities such as Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to control the game. The inclusion of cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Zulaport Cutthroat provides additional win conditions, while Boseiju, Who Endures can help protect key combo pieces.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of efficient counter spells and aggressive creatures to maintain control of the board while also applying pressure to the opponent. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, while also utilizing versatile threats like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly close out games. The inclusion of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat helps to deal with opposing threats, while cards like Counterspell and Force of Negation provide protection against key spells from the opponent.

This deck focuses on cycling through cards quickly, disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Grief and Force of Negation, and eventually casting Living End to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard. The goal is to set up a massive board presence while emptying the opponent's side of the battlefield, overwhelming them with a combination of speed and disruptive elements. The deck's synergy between cycling creatures, cascade spells, and the Living End finisher makes it a potent and unpredictable force in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana quickly, allowing for powerful plays with high-cost spells and artifacts. It heavily relies on controlling the game through removal, disruption, and graveyard hate, while also utilizing powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Wurmcoil Engine, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also has access to Karn, the Great Creator to tutor for specific artifacts and shut down opposing strategies. Overall, the key concept of this deck is resource management and controlling the game tempo through powerful spells and permanents.

The main focus of this deck is to deal quick and consistent damage to the opponent through a combination of burn spells and aggressive creatures. By utilizing efficient and powerful cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Goblin Guide, the deck aims to pressure the opponent early and prevent them from stabilizing. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Roiling Vortex and Skullcrack helps to disrupt any potential life gain or stabilization strategies from the opponent, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive momentum and secure a quick victory.
